assertion.uniformity: Finite frequency count and positive radius/correlation constants depend only oneta.

assertion.normalizations: Fractional parts in[-1/2,1/2), arbitrary real coefficient lifts, additive characters alpha=xi/P.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Empty frequency set gives a constant test. Small eta requirement met by a fixed lower threshold.

assertion.statement: Failed one-variable total equidistribution gives a fixed horizontal character with bounded C-infinity coefficients, and an actual proper connected-kernel factorization.
assertion.objects: The normalized orbit gtilde=c^-1 g lambda^-1 with value1 at0; adapted coordinate coefficients t_r; standard integer character k.
assertion.hypotheses: A dense progression and a positive discrepancy witness failure; fixed rational basis complexity is absorbed by decreasing standard delta.
assertion.quantifiers: For every polynomial g failing total equidistribution; all integer n in the factor identity; every Taylor index up to fixed degree.
assertion.parameter_range: One variable only, any fixed filtered dimension and degree; internal tests require standard Lipschitz norm.
assertion.uniformity: Finite character bound gives standard k; all smoothness/denominator bounds depend on fixed delta and geometry, not N.
assertion.constants: k.t_r nearest-integer error O(N^-r); v_r=a_r u_r and w_r=(k.t_r-a_r)u_r.
assertion.normalizations: k.psi is a real lift killing commutators; real zero puts p in connected kernel, not merely circle kernel.
assertion.exceptional_cases: If k vanishes on a coordinate support, choose v_r=w_r=a_r=0. Rational numerators may be unbounded.
assertion.limit_order: Witness failure first, choose standard delta, normalize g0, then use the one-variable theorem and its coordinate construction.
